blind_target.authors: Block VJ, Lizee A, Crabtree-Hartman E, Bevan C, Graves J, Bove R.
blind_target.evidence_quote: We obtained the original activity data from the CA ( 11 ,  12 ) and VA ( 13 ) cohorts, harmonized overlapping variables collected in both studies, and conducted secondary data analyses to replicate analyses in the CA cohort using the VA dataset ( 13 ).
blind_target.outcome_quote: Mirroring the approach used in the CA cohort ( 11 ,  12 ) study of 97 participants with MS using wrist-worn Fitbit activity monitors, we replicated key findings in the VA cohort ( 13 ) of 61 participants with MS with less severe disability, assessed using the hip-worn ActiGraph sensors.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Overall verdict explicitly states key findings of the CA studies (11, 12) were replicated in the independent VA cohort; smaller correlations and reliability are not framed as replication failure.
blind_target.title: Continuous daily assessment of multiple sclerosis disability using remote step count monitoring.
